item.title: Vuetify vs Element Plus vs Naive UI in 2026: Which Vue Component Library Should You Use?
item.description: Choosing a Vue component library in 2026 feels like a three-way standoff: Vuetify (41,030 stars), Element Plus (27,679 stars), and Naive UI (18,494 stars) all solve the same problem, yet they lead to completely different developer experiences. Pick wrong and you will spend your first sprint re-theming a component set that fights your design system — pick right and your admin panel ships in days. This comparison is based on live repository data, hands-on API surface differences, and the upgrade paths each library forces on you.
